evals.prompt: 다음 확정된 시놉시스를 러프 서사 패널 정확히 6개로 그려 주세요 — 제작용 촬영·카메라 사양 없이 패널 연습만 필요합니다. 비 오는 밤, 한 학생이 늦게까지 불이 켜진 문구점 창가 진열을 따라 할머니가 잃어버린 편지를 찾습니다. 편지는 할머니가 창가 진열함 안에 끼워 둔 채 비를 피해 있었습니다.
evals.expected_output: A six-panel Korean visual storyboard with one readable action per panel, motivated progression, foreshadowed discovery, and a consistent six-cell sheet prompt.
expectations: Exactly six ordered panels, each centered on one readable visible action or beat.
Panel transitions follow the supplied premise rather than unrelated invented events.
The window display or its sheltered interior is visually foreshadowed before the letter is discovered, and the final panel resolves the search there.
The output stays at panel level — no shot timing, camera-move breakdown, or clip segmentation.
A single consistent six-cell sheet prompt preserves the student, rainy night storefront, display case, and dry letter without claiming image generation; the output is in Korean.

evals.prompt: 지하철역을 가로질러 초록 우산을 돌려주는 수리공 장면을 러프 서사 패널 5개로 스토리보드화해 주세요 — 제작 사양 없이 패널 연습만. 우산은 연두색이고 손잡이 끈이 닳았으며, 돌려줄 때까지 수리공의 왼손에 들려 있습니다.
evals.expected_output: A five-panel Korean storyboard keeping the umbrella's color, worn strap, and left-hand possession until the return is depicted, without inventing explanations.
expectations: Exactly five ordered panels, each with a clear narrative function.
The umbrella stays light green with the frayed wrist strap in the repair person's left hand until the return is shown.
Any change in ownership or hand appears as an explicit panel event, never a silent switch between prompts.
Prompts repeat only continuity-critical details and invent no recipient identity, station incident, backstory, or extra prop as fact.
The output is in Korean and prompts make no image-generation claim.

evals.prompt: 다음 제공된 테스트 수치만으로 마을 재활용 센터 홍보 영상의 러프 서사 패널 4개를 만들어 주세요 — 제작 사양 없이 패널 연습만. 첫해에 40톤, 둘째 해에 52톤을 수거했습니다. 수가 변한 이유를 주장하지 마세요.
evals.expected_output: A four-panel Korean factual storyboard visualizing only the supplied tonnage and keeping the cause of the change unknown.
expectations: Exactly four ordered panels using 40 tonnes in year one and 52 tonnes in year two accurately; any derived difference is labeled arithmetic.
Each panel has one clear informational function or visible action; the sequence never becomes an invented anecdote.
The cause of the change is explicitly unknown or unstated — no external statistic, source, or causal explanation is invented.
Image prompts add no invented facility, staff, equipment, or records as evidence and make no image-generation claim.
The output is in Korean.

evals.prompt: 승인된 20초 무대사 이야기: CH01이 창가에서 빨간 장갑을 발견하고 출구에서 장갑을 찾는 CH02를 알아본 뒤 다가가 돌려주고 둘이 안도한다. 창작 staging은 위임한다. 영상 제작용 상세 스토리보드를 텍스트로 설계해줘. 이미지 컷만 순서대로 놓아도 이야기가 읽혀야 한다. 생성·지출은 하지 마.
evals.expected_output: An indexed complete production storyboard with technical handoffs and an honest image-only review gate, not a claimed rendered result.
expectations: Every synopsis beat/source location, scene, shot and required start/peak/end or hold panel mapped; no representative-only board presented as full coverage.
Camera size/angle/framing/movement, spatial/Blender branch, VFX, speech/lipsync and audio cues explicitly connected, including reasoned non-applicability.
Image-slot, unique-image and sheet counts distinguished; individual images carry visible states, with management labels outside clean cuts.
Image-only review compares actual read events and causal/ownership/emotional changes to synopsis, not mere panel count; actual media remains unverified.
KEEP/FIX/unverified, minimal repair/preserve/prerequisites and estimate basis provided; unsupported labor times remain unknown.
Indexed clean-cut and first/peak/end frame handoff preserves IDs and verified endpoint limits without execution or media claims.

evals.prompt: 이 제공 콘티를 고쳐줘: 원문 B01 발견→B02 반환→B03 안도인데 이미지 P01은 발견, P02는 둘이 웃음뿐이다. 장갑 반환 접촉 컷과 캐릭터/음향 매핑이 빠져 있다. 기존 이야기와 정상 P01은 유지한다. 이미지 파일은 아직 없고 Blender도 실행 불가다. 유료 생성은 하지 마.
evals.expected_output: An index-specific repair plan for missing causal imagery and metadata, with exact blockers and no fabricated render.
expectations: B02 missing visual evidence is blocker; preserves valid P01 and fixed story rather than rebuilding all panels.
Adds staged before/contact/after states for ownership transfer, with technical and character/audio links.
Lists KEEP/FIX/unverified, repair reason/method/prerequisites and grounded estimate or unknown.
Blender and actual image review stay unverified, no runtime fallback or claimed completed media.
Corrected text is not presented as accepted image-only storyboard.

evals.prompt: 캐릭터 없는 무음 숫자 설명 영상의 상세 콘티를 설계해줘. 승인 사실은 올해 40건, 다음해 52건뿐이고 증가 원인은 모른다. 15초, 생성/저장 없이 텍스트만. 두 숫자가 순서대로 이미지에서 읽히게 해줘.
evals.expected_output: A full indexed factual storyboard respecting no-audio and unknown causation.
expectations: No fictional cast, voice, music, facilities or causal claims.
Required scene/shot/beat/panel technical slots present with explicit spatial/VFX/speech/audio non-applicability where appropriate.
Approved data graphics remain visible in image-only review, while external explanatory labels/audio are hidden.
Runtime coverage and required image counts explicit; no generated media, files or paid job claimed.

evals.prompt: 승인된 20초 무대사 이야기: CH01이 창가에서 빨간 장갑을 발견하고 출구에서 장갑을 찾는 CH02에게 다가가 돌려주고 둘이 안도한다. staging은 위임한다. 콘티를 작성해줘. 텍스트만 반환하고 실제 생성/저장/지출은 하지 마.
evals.expected_output: An unqualified storyboard request defaults to a complete production plan, not a narrow narrative thumbnail list.
expectations: Returns integrated input/coverage/shot/panel/count-and-handoff/review sections with all mandatory technical slots.
The pickup, approach, contact and final possession supply causal visual coverage rather than skipping to relief.
Consistent hand/ownership/space states across ledgers, panel prompts and shot specifications; contradictions are FIX.
Keeps actual image-only quality and Blender execution unverified, distinguishes text planning from finished artwork, and invents no labor time.
